# Project / Module Name

One-paragraph description of what this project or module does and who it is for.

## Prerequisites

- Node (version pinned in `.nvmrc` / `.node-version`)
- Any service dependencies (database, cache, etc.)

## Install

```bash
npm install
```

## Usage

```bash
npm run dev      # start in watch mode
npm run build    # compile to dist/
npm start        # run the compiled output
```

## Scripts

Document the npm scripts a contributor will use day to day (lint, test, check,
etc.). Link to the root README's script table rather than duplicating it.

## Testing

```bash
npm test
npm run test:coverage
```

## Contributing

Branching model, commit convention (Conventional Commits), and the local quality
gate (`npm run check:all`).
